info.syllabusName: Kỹ năng lập hồ sơ xin việc & trả lời phỏng vấn (Anh) (Job Application and Interview Skills)
info.description: The module helps students know the importance and tips to write an impressive CV. It also supplies students with a list of common job interview questions, examples of the best answers about applicant's work history and experience, the job, goals and what to offer the employer.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Remember a general knowledge of the application and some issues related to the form and content of interviews when applying for a job.
Understand the importance and significance of a resume in the application process as well as rules when being in an interview.
Apply knowledge and skills to write an effective and impressive CV; conduct and solve questions and situations when being interviewed
